summary: Oconto County, WI tower listed as gone by FFLA; sources give no build, staffing or removal dates. A 1937 ranger station on W Stiles Tower Rd is not linked to it.

notes_for_editor: Thin record. Tower evidence is directory level only: the FFLA county list (Tower Gone), a Forest Lookouts page with the county and no other text, and OSM tags. The WHS record is a 1937 Stiles Ranger Station on the east side of W Stiles Tower Rd, listed as demolished; it does not mention a tower. It is the only local clue and the story says the link is not established. A 1971 Oconto County Reporter item about the community of Stiles appeared in a search snippet; it was not read, and the snippet did not mention a tower. The Mountain Fire Lookout (a different Oconto County tower, standing) came up repeatedly in search and is not used. OSM node 353894115 (44.8305473, -88.0737144, elevation 218 m) is about 20 m from the FFLA point; the node is not verified against the structure. Web searches: 2. Page reads: about 5.
